verdict.rationale: E2B has no documented region picker for its managed cloud. Its own deployment options do let customers control data location: an official Terraform-based self-hosting guide (e2b-gh-2) and BYOC deployments referenced in the client docs (e2b-docs-30, e2b-docs-34). Residency is therefore achievable only by running E2B on your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: region selection in the managed service, explicit data-residency documentation or guarantees, BYOC details beyond passing mentions, and independent corroboration.
